sources.snippet: Kenga by GermannM is a 1.5 billion parameter transformer decoder language model with a 32K token context length, uniquely designed with a distinct identity and values. It is primarily optimized for the Russian language, excelling in direct, concise responses and possessing knowledge of the Kenga programming language and Z-system concepts.
